				<div class="et_pb_text_inner"><p>Located in the Boat Yard of The Farmhouse Hotel, our PODS are clean, well equipped and set up with kiters in mind. Each POD features 2 beds, a mini fridge, deck with BBQ and cooking basics. Communal ablution facilities include showers, toilets and urinals. The secure parking, ample kite drying space and close proximity to Langebaans best kiting spots make the PODS the perfect lock up and go stay for kiters visiting the West Coast.</p>

				<div class="et_pb_text_inner"><h1>STAY</h1>
<p>Our super clean PODS sleep 2 in either a double bed or 2 single beds and feature a dedicated toilet and shower cubicle in the ablution pod. Complete with a private deck fitted with a BBQ, these pods are designed for the discerning adventure traveller, looking for an affordable, fun place to stay while kiting and exploring Langebaan.</p>
<p></p>
<p>POD’s – <span>From R275 per person sharing</span></p></div>

				<div class="et_pb_text_inner"><h1 style="text-align: center;">Introducing a unique new concept</h1>
<h3 style="text-align: center;">NO WIND &#8211; NO PAY<br /> Kite Basecamps</h3>
<p style="text-align: center;">At Kite Basecamp, we believe that every kite holiday must be as memorable as possible. We have therefore designed this exclusive policy with our Kitesurfing guests in mind.</p>
<p style="text-align: center;">No Wind-No Pay Policy dictates that kitesurfer bookings may be cancelled 24 hours prior to the confirmed check-in date with no loss of deposit, should the wind be forecasted, at less than 13 knots for the day of arrival.</p>
<p style="text-align: center;"><em>*Standard cancellation terms will apply should the wind be forecasted at 14 knots or above. The above policy does not apply to the peak periods between Christmas and New Years, as well as Easter and certain long weekends or during specific special events.</em></p></div>
